video_title: Lakers Legend Has A Message For LeBron & Austin Reaves - Mason and Ireland

quotes.speaker: Robert Horry
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers need to build a team to beat top contenders
quotes.excerpt: They got to build to be OKC, they got to build to beat San Antonio

text_blocks.speaker: Robert Horry
text_blocks.text: You think about the days when we won three in a row. So many guys got jobs because they were there to try to stop Shaq. And so many guys got paid because they needed a big body. There is no big body for Wemby. You got to find someone who is a tall defensive player who can deter some of the things, who can move his feet. The Lakers got to build to be OKC, they got to build to beat San Antonio because that is what good teams do. You realize who you are and you look at the teams that are dominating and you build your team to try to beat them.

text_blocks.speaker: Mason
text_blocks.text: You said right there, who knows what is going on with LeBron because of the summer of LeBron again. It is his decision, he has earned every single right to make whatever he wants to do, when he wants to do it.

quotes.speaker: Robert Horry
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves must prioritize his own best interests
quotes.excerpt: At the end of the day, his life. He has to do what is best for him.

text_blocks.speaker: Robert Horry
text_blocks.text: I think with Reaves, he has to do what is best for him. Sometimes fans forget that. We want him to stay, but at the end of the day, his life. He has to do what is best for him. Let's say some team is going to offer you 180 million and the Lakers are going to offer you 120 million. That is 40 million dollars. I know Austin very well. He is not the sexiest guy so he is not going to get other off-court endorsements, so he has to make up that 40 million.

text_blocks.speaker: Mason
text_blocks.text: But does he want to go play in Brooklyn? I love AR, I love him too, but at the end of the day you have to do what is best for you.

quotes.speaker: Robert Horry
quotes.summary_phrase: Analytics should not be applied to the NBA playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Analytics only happens for 82. Analytics does not happen in the playoffs.
quotes.quote: If everybody is looking at what Kenny Atkinson said, they should throw analytics out the window. Analytics only happens for 82. Analytics does not happen in the playoffs because you get a chance to lock in on a team for four games, five games, six games, wherever it may be. So analytics need to be tossed out the window because I know how to stop your favorite play. It is not just one night where I am coming off a back-to-back or I am coming off a team who just playing someone I don't really care about. Think about how many times teams lose to teams that you are like, there is no way in the world they should have lost the team. So analytics only counts for 82. Analytics should never be applied in the playoffs.
